Several **SEO providers offer fixed monthly subscriptions under $150**, including **WebCEO** at **$119/mo** for its Startup plan, with fixed pricing and no additional charges on that plan.[1] **Semrush** also has a plan starting at **$117.33/mo billed annually** (or **$139/mo** month-to-month), which is under $150.[6] **4Core Digital** lists a **Starter** package at **$149/month**.[15] **RankYak** advertises a **flat $99/month** subscription with no tiers or upsells.[20]

A few other low-cost options from the results are:
- **Ranked.ai**: **$99/mo** fixed monthly subscription.[11]
- **Embarque**: **$299/mo** starting price, so *not* under $150.[11]
- **DPOM**: **$249/mo** and up, so *not* under $150.[10]
- **Third Marble Marketing**: starts at **$499/mo**, so *not* under $150.[9]

If you want, I can turn this into a **shortlist of the best under-$150 providers** with notes on whether they are *software tools* or *done-for-you SEO services*.
